description: Welcome to this beautifully refreshed 4-bedroom, 2-bath home on a desirable corner lot with approximately 7,405 sq. ft. of lot space and 1,362 sq. ft. of living area. This home has great curb appeal, a spacious driveway, and a clean, move-in-ready feel from the moment you arrive.    Inside, you'll find a bright and comfortable layout with fresh interior and exterior paint, updated bathrooms, a cozy fireplace in the living room, and a functional kitchen with plenty of cabinet space. The home feels clean, practical, and ready for its next owner.    The backyard features a covered patio, giving you a great space for BBQs, relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying outdoor living year-round. With its corner lot location, refreshed condition, updated bathrooms, and move-in-ready appeal, this home checks a lot of boxes.    Don't miss your chance to see this beautiful home  clean, refreshed, and ready to go.
